title: Investment Tool Insights (Exent.ai and Alinea compared)? First Hand Experiences?
author: codenerd80
selftext: I have accounts at the major investment firms (Fidelity, Vanguard, etc.) but lately I have been seeing ads for the above two advisors. They claim to be able to use AI and/or other metrics to get you better returns. Has anyone had any direct experience with them? No company shills please, I’m looking for authentic experiences from parties not related to the companies. Thank you in advance.

comments.author: Eastern-Cat-5072
comments.body:
I've tried both just recently after seeing the same ads probably. Alinea was too much for me... Simply because I am a passive investor. 

Exent on the other hand was better. I booked a call with one of their teammembers and it went really well. I am still considering their price, simply because my potfolio is not big enough.. But what they are showing and after Luke explained how this whole market prediction thing works, I think I will deffinetly come back when I have more money.
